passages.text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: “Go to the house of the Rechabites, speak to them, and bring them to one of the chambers of the house of the LORD to offer them a drink of wine.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeremiah during the reign of Jehoiakim.
Jehoiakim was the son of Josiah.
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
God gave Jeremiah a message.
God told Jeremiah to go to the house of the Rechabites.
God told Jeremiah to speak to the Rechabites.
God told Jeremiah to bring the Rechabites into the house of the LORD.
God told Jeremiah to take them to one of the chambers in the house of the LORD.
God told Jeremiah to offer the Rechabites wine to drink.
passages.original: הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֥ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה בִּימֵ֨י יְהוֹיָקִ֧ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֛הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ הָלוֹךְ֮ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית הָרֵכָבִים֒ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אוֹתָ֔ם וַהֲבִֽאוֹתָם֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ אַחַ֖ת הַלְּשָׁכ֑וֹת וְהִשְׁקִיתָ֥ אוֹתָ֖ם יָֽיִן׃

passages.text: So I took Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons—the entire house of the Rechabites— and I brought them into the house of the LORD, to a chamber occupied by the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God. This room was near the chamber of the officials, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah during the days of Jehoiakim, king of Judah.
Jeremiah took Jaazaniah.
Jaazaniah was the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah.
Jeremiah also took Jaazaniah’s brothers.
Jeremiah took all the sons of Jaazaniah.
Jeremiah took the entire house of the Rechabites.
Jeremiah brought them into the house of the LORD.
He brought them to a chamber.
The sons of Hanan, son of Igdaliah, a man of God, occupied this chamber.
This chamber was next to the chamber of the officials.
The officials’ chamber was above the chamber of Maaseiah.
Maaseiah was the son of Shallum.
Shallum was the doorkeeper.
passages.original: וָאֶקַּ֞ח אֶת־ יַאֲזַנְיָ֤ה בֶֽן־ יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ חֲבַצִּנְיָ֔ה וְאֶת־ אֶחָ֖יו וְאֶת־ כָּל־ בָּנָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית הָרֵכָבִֽים׃ וָאָבִ֤א אֹתָם֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ לִשְׁכַּ֗ת בְּנֵ֛י חָנָ֥ן בֶּן־ יִגְדַּלְיָ֖הוּ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר־ אֵ֙צֶל֙ לִשְׁכַּ֣ת הַשָּׂרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִמַּ֗עַל לְלִשְׁכַּ֛ת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ שַׁלֻּ֖ם שֹׁמֵ֥ר הַסַּֽף׃

passages.text: Then I set pitchers full of wine and some cups before the men of the house of the Rechabites, and I said to them, “Drink some wine.”
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah during the days of Jehoiakim, king of Judah.
The LORD told Jeremiah to go to the house of the Rechabites.
The Rechabites were a family group in Judah.
Jeremiah gathered the Rechabites and brought them into the house of the LORD.
He brought them to a chamber in the temple.
Jeremiah placed pitchers full of wine in front of the Rechabites.
He also set cups before them.
Jeremiah said to the Rechabites, "Drink some wine."
passages.original: וָאֶתֵּ֞ן לִפְנֵ֣י׀ בְּנֵ֣י בֵית־ הָרֵכָבִ֗ים גְּבִעִ֛ים מְלֵאִ֥ים יַ֖יִן וְכֹס֑וֹת וָאֹמַ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁתוּ־ יָֽיִן׃

passages.text: “We do not drink wine,” they replied, “for our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab commanded us, ‘Neither you nor your descendants are ever to drink wine.
passages.sermon:
The Rechabites answered.
They said, “We do not drink wine.
Our forefather is Jonadab son of Rechab.
Jonadab commanded us.
He said, ‘Do not drink wine.
You must not drink wine.
Your children must not drink wine.
This command lasts forever.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֣א נִשְׁתֶּה־ יָּ֑יִן כִּי֩ יוֹנָדָ֨ב בֶּן־ רֵכָ֜ב אָבִ֗ינוּ צִוָּ֤ה עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֧א תִשְׁתּוּ־ יַ֛יִן אַתֶּ֥ם וּבְנֵיכֶ֖ם עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard. Those things are not for you. Instead, you must live in tents all your lives, so that you may live a long time in the land where you wander.’
passages.sermon:
Jonadab was the forefather of the Rechabites.
Jonadab gave commands to the Rechabites.
He told them not to build houses.
He told them not to sow seed.
He told them not to plant vineyards.
He told them not to own these things.
He told them to live in tents all their lives.
He said this would help them live a long time.
He said they would live long in the land where they wander.
passages.original: וּבַ֣יִת לֹֽא־ תִבְנ֗וּ וְזֶ֤רַע לֹֽא־ תִזְרָ֙עוּ֙ וְכֶ֣רֶם לֹֽא־ תִטָּ֔עוּ וְלֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶ֖ה לָכֶ֑ם כִּ֠י בָּאֳהָלִ֤ים תֵּֽשְׁבוּ֙ כָּל־ יְמֵיכֶ֔ם לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּ יָמִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם גָּרִ֥ים שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: And we have obeyed the voice of our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab in all he commanded us. So we have not drunk wine all our lives—neither we nor our wives nor our sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Jonadab was the son of Rechab.  
He was our forefather.  
He gave us commands.  
We listened to his voice.  
We obeyed everything he told us.  
He told us not to drink wine.  
We have not drunk wine all our lives.  
Our wives have not drunk wine.  
Our sons have not drunk wine.  
Our daughters have not drunk wine.
passages.original: וַנִּשְׁמַ֗ע בְּק֨וֹל יְהוֹנָדָ֤ב בֶּן־ רֵכָב֙ אָבִ֔ינוּ לְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֑נוּ לְבִלְתִּ֤י שְׁתֽוֹת־ יַ֙יִן֙ כָּל־ יָמֵ֔ינוּ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ נָשֵׁ֔ינוּ בָּנֵ֖ינוּ וּבְנֹתֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Nor have we built houses in which to live, and we have not owned any vineyards or fields or crops.
passages.sermon:
We have not built houses to live in.
We do not own vineyards.
We do not own fields.
We do not have crops.
passages.original: וּלְבִלְתִּ֛י בְּנ֥וֹת בָּתִּ֖ים לְשִׁבְתֵּ֑נוּ וְכֶ֧רֶם וְשָׂדֶ֛ה וָזֶ֖רַע לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: But we have lived in tents and have obeyed and done exactly as our forefather Jonadab commanded us.
passages.sermon:
We are the descendants of Jonadab son of Rechab.
Jonadab was our forefather.
He gave us commands.
We have lived in tents.
We have obeyed Jonadab’s commands.
We have done everything he told us to do.
passages.original: וַנֵּ֖שֶׁב בָּֽאֳהָלִ֑ים וַנִּשְׁמַ֣ע וַנַּ֔עַשׂ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖נוּ יוֹנָדָ֥ב אָבִֽינוּ׃

passages.text: So when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched into the land, we said: ‘Come, let us go into Jerusalem to escape the armies of the Chaldeans and the Arameans.’ So we have remained in Jerusalem.”
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.
He marched into the land.
We saw the armies of the Chaldeans.
We saw the armies of the Arameans.
We said, “Come, let us go into Jerusalem to escape them.”
We entered Jerusalem.
We have stayed in Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בַּעֲל֨וֹת נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֮ אֶל־ הָאָרֶץ֒ וַנֹּ֗אמֶר בֹּ֚אוּ וְנָב֣וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִפְּנֵי֙ חֵ֣יל הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וּמִפְּנֵ֖י חֵ֣יל אֲרָ֑ם וַנֵּ֖שֶׁב בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem: ‘Will you not accept discipline and obey My words?’ declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD is the LORD of Hosts.
The LORD gave Jeremiah a message.
The LORD said, “Go to the men of Judah.
Go to the people who live in Jerusalem.
Say this to them:
‘Will you not accept discipline?
Will you not obey My words?’
The LORD declares this.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הָלֹ֤ךְ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּלְיֽוֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הֲל֨וֹא תִקְח֥וּ מוּסָ֛ר לִשְׁמֹ֥עַ אֶל־ דְּבָרַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The words of Jonadab son of Rechab have been carried out. He commanded his sons not to drink wine, and they have not drunk it to this very day because they have obeyed the command of their forefather. But I have spoken to you again and again, and you have not obeyed Me!
passages.sermon:
Jonadab was the son of Rechab.
Jonadab gave a command to his sons.
He told them not to drink wine.
His sons have obeyed him.
They have not drunk wine until this very day.
They listened to the command of their father.
I am the LORD.
I have spoken to you many times.
I have spoken to you again and again.
You have not obeyed Me.
passages.original: הוּקַ֡ם אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוֹנָדָ֣ב בֶּן־ רֵ֠כָב אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֨ה אֶת־ בָּנָ֜יו לְבִלְתִּ֣י שְׁתֽוֹת־ יַ֗יִן וְלֹ֤א שָׁתוּ֙ עַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י שָֽׁמְע֔וּ אֵ֖ת מִצְוַ֣ת אֲבִיהֶ֑ם וְאָ֨נֹכִ֜י דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְדַבֵּ֔ר וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: Again and again I have sent you all My servants the prophets, proclaiming: ‘Turn now, each of you, from your wicked ways, and correct your actions. Do not go after other gods to serve them. Live in the land that I have given to you and your fathers.’ But you have not inclined your ear or listened to Me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD sent His servants to you.
His servants are the prophets.
The LORD sent them again and again.
The prophets spoke to you.
They said, "Turn from your evil ways."
They said, "Change your actions for the better."
They said, "Do not follow other gods."
They said, "Do not serve other gods."
They said, "Live in the land I gave to you."
They said, "Live in the land I gave to your fathers."
You did not listen to the prophets.
You did not pay attention to Me.
passages.original: וָאֶשְׁלַ֣ח אֲלֵיכֶ֣ם אֶת־ כָּל־ עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִאִ֣ים׀ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ים וְשָׁלֹ֣חַ׀ לֵאמֹ֡ר שֻׁבוּ־ נָ֡א אִישׁ֩ מִדַּרְכּ֨וֹ הָרָעָ֜ה וְהֵיטִ֣יבוּ מַֽעַלְלֵיכֶ֗ם וְאַל־ תֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ אַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ לְעָבְדָ֔ם וּשְׁבוּ֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תִּי לָכֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֤א הִטִּיתֶם֙ אֶֽת־ אָזְנְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: Yes, the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not listened to Me.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Jonadab son of Rechab obeyed their father’s command.
Jonadab son of Rechab told his sons what to do.
His sons did what he said.
But these people did not listen to Me.
I am the LORD.
These people did not obey Me.
passages.original: כִּ֣י הֵקִ֗ימוּ בְּנֵי֙ יְהוֹנָדָ֣ב בֶּן־ רֵכָ֔ב אֶת־ מִצְוַ֥ת אֲבִיהֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֑ם וְהָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ אֵלָֽי׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will bring to Judah and to all the residents of Jerusalem all the disaster I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them but they have not obeyed, and I have called to them but they have not answered.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Hosts.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD says this.
I will bring disaster to Judah.
I will bring disaster to all who live in Jerusalem.
I have already spoken about this disaster.
I have told them what I will do.
I will do this because I spoke to them.
They did not listen to Me.
I called to them.
They did not answer Me.
passages.original: לָ֠כֵן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֧י מֵבִ֣יא אֶל־ יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶ֤ל כָּל־ יֽוֹשְׁבֵי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם יַ֣עַן דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֔עוּ וָאֶקְרָ֥א לָהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א עָנֽוּ׃

passages.text: Then Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you have obeyed the command of your forefather Jonadab and have kept all his commandments and have done all that he charged you to do, this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Jonadab son of Rechab will never fail to have a man to stand before Me.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah spoke to the house of the Rechabites.
The Rechabites were a family in Israel.
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
The LORD said this to the Rechabites.
You obeyed the command of your forefather Jonadab.
You kept all his commandments.
You did everything he told you to do.
Because you obeyed Jonadab, I will bless you.
The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says this.
Jonadab son of Rechab will always have a man to stand before Me.
This promise will last for all time.
passages.original: וּלְבֵ֨ית הָרֵכָבִ֜ים אָמַ֣ר יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁמַעְתֶּ֔ם עַל־ מִצְוַ֖ת יְהוֹנָדָ֣ב אֲבִיכֶ֑ם וַֽתִּשְׁמְרוּ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֔יו וַֽתַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖ה אֶתְכֶֽם׃ס לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֨ת אִ֜ישׁ לְיוֹנָדָ֧ב בֶּן־ רֵכָ֛ב עֹמֵ֥ד לְפָנַ֖י כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃פ
